heraliz_ping.roue.rappel: Release to mark · right click: cancel
heraliz_ping.msg.cadence: Easy: too many pings at once.
heraliz_ping.msg.portee: Too far to mark (%s blocks at most).
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.bref: Tap the key: marks what you aim at (the type is picked for you: loot, enemy, let's go).
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.roue: Hold the key: the wheel opens. Point at a type with the mouse, release to mark.
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.annuler: Tap on one of your own pings: it goes away.
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.qui: Only your clan (or your team in a match, or your group) sees your pings.
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.touche: Default key: front side mouse button. Change it in Options > Controls > HeraliZ Ping.
